base.summary: Tight thermal dispatch, sub-seasonal storage; GB Power holds premium, DA power near 190 EUR/MWh.

downside.summary: Temperature normalisation, hydro inflows recover, storage build accelerates, nuclear capacity restored.

upside.summary: Next heat wave deepens nuclear cooling crisis; Danube falls further or France/Germany outages spike.

themes: Marine heat waves suppress nuclear and hydro; fuel-switch regime tightens
GB power premium extends; storage deficit persists into autumn
US LNG surge and Iran sanctions risk shift TTF arbs over months
Rosatom safety scrutiny clouds EU nuclear expansion timeline
top_drivers: Marine heat waves across Europe reduce nuclear and hydro cooling capacity; fuel-switching to gas/coal lifts DA and Cal+1 power spreads and pressures EUA via higher thermal dispatch carbon.
Storage 17.1 pp below 5-yr seasonal average; refill pace through Q3 will determine Q4 heating-season carry cost and power premium extension.
US LNG production surge (122.5 Bcf/d projected 2026) widens Henry Hub–TTF discount, weakening European gas and power via cheaper fuel-switching arbs.
top_takeaway: GB Power at 99th-percentile amid marine heat-wave nuclear constraints; storage 17pp below seasonal average tightens H2 refill risk.

watchlist.metric: Danube water levels and Paks II nuclear output
watchlist.why: Heat-driven low water reduces Hungarian baseload; directly pressures Central EU power spreads and forces upward fuel-switching into gas.

watchlist.metric: EU nuclear cooling constraints (France, Germany, Spain)
watchlist.why: Marine heat waves threaten continent-wide thermal dispatch; next heat spike will compress available capacity and widen spot-to-forward spreads.

watchlist.metric: Storage refill trajectory (EU 61.37%, −17.1 pp below seasonal)
watchlist.why: Sub-seasonal build through August-September sets Q4 carry cost and heating-season supply cushion; underfill will extend power premium through winter.

watchlist.metric: US LNG export calendar and Henry Hub–TTF arb
watchlist.why: EIA projects record 122.5 Bcf/d US natgas in 2026; higher LNG supply over months will widen TTF discount vs. Henry Hub, pressing EU power via gas fuel-switch.

watchlist.metric: EU sanctions decision on Rosatom (Paks II permit risk)
watchlist.why: Ukraine seeks sanctions on Russian nuclear firm; permit delays or supply-chain disruption to Hungary plant would defer EU baseload capacity and extend power-cost regime.
